AI-powered features

Automated, preventive IT operations monitoring and troubleshooting to surface, understand and proactively solve complex IT issues across your stack

01

Detect and Correlate

Automatically identify early signals of complex and hidden IT system issues, across your infrastructure, network and applications.

  • Proactively spot unusual patterns and anomalies from logs, alerts and system health data
  • Get context aware issue correlation by understanding service relations and dependencies
  • Drill down to see the root cause of an identified issue
02

Inform and Recommend

Automate troubleshooting and proactively notify the IT team about detected issues and recommend solutions.

  • Real-time issue notifications across multiple communication channels
  • Natural-language explanations and recommendations for fast issue resolution
  • Streamlined issue investigation and work status tracking
03

Investigate and Discover

Provide unified observability and easy-to-read answers to complex questions.

  • Natural-language and SQL query language for advanced search
  • Unified and scoped search across all IT system data
  • Reducing millions of events into meaningful pattern groups
04

Monitor and Visualize

Build your knowledge base with powerful analytics with robust built- in and custom visualisations.

  • Real-time dashboards for a live overview of system performance and key operational metrics
  • Custom visualizations tailored to user needs and specific use cases
  • Built-in dashboards for a comprehensive global overview of the IT landscape
